title: Rezon
summary: Raleigh names Rezon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Rezon, also printed Razon and Rezin the sonne of Eliadad, the second of the Adads, who possest Damascus after Adadezer and was an enemie to Salomon. He is not Rezin the last King of Damascus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XI, §. I, sig. 252b
